༄༅/ /chos skyong spyi'i bskang bshags gur mgon zhal dang bcas pa'i bstod pa bzhugs so/ /

tei:div.tei:p: ¿༄༅/ /chos skyong spyi'i bskang bshags gur mgon zhal dang bcas pa'i bstod pa bzhugs so/ /

na mo gu ru ratna tra yaṃ dharmā pā la ya/ rdo rje 'chang dbang rtsa brgyud bla ma dang*| |yi dam dkyil 'khor rgyal ba rgya mtsho'i tshogs/ /mthu ldan dam pa bstan srung 'khor dang bcas/ /skyabs gnas dam pa mchog rnams dgongs su gsol| |thog med dus nas chags sdang gti mug gis/ /bgyis dang bgyid stsal yi rang sdig pa'i tshogs/ /gang bgyis 'gyod pa'i sems kyis bshags par bgyi/ /bzod par bzhes nas tshangs par stsal du gsol/ /mi shes pa dang bag med ma gus dang*/ /nyon mongs mang bas bgyi bar 'os pa'i las/ /ma bgyis pa dang mi 'os bgyis pa yis/ /sems rgyud sdig pas sbags pa mthol lo bshags/ /rnyed dka'i dal 'byor rin chen thob dus 'dir/ /don med tshe 'di'i bya ba lhur blangs nas/ /bshes gnyen ma bsten sdom gsum ma blangs pas| |dal 'byor stong log bgyis pa mthol lo bshags/ /so so thar pa'i sdom pa khas blangs nas/ /spong bdun spong ba bzhi dang bslab bzhi lnga/ /sems bskyed sbyor ba'i sbyor ba dang sbyor ba/ /dngos gzhi ltung bas gos pa mthol lo bshags| |byang chub sems dpa'i sdom pa khas blangs nas/ /rtsa ba bzhi dang nyes byas bzhi bcu lnga/ /zag pa chung 'bring sems can blos spong sogs/ /theg chen ltung bas gos pa mthol lo bshags/ /rig 'dzin sngags kyi sdom pa khas blangs nas/ /rgyud sde bzhi yi rtsa ba yan lag gi /spyi dang khyad par dam tshig sdom pa las/ /'gal zhing nongs par gyur pa mthol lo bshags/ /'jig rten 'jig rten 'das pa'i dge legs kyi/ /'byung gnas mthar thug bla ma dam pa la| |rang gi 'dod don cung zad ma grub nas/ /sgo gsum log bsgrubs bgyis pa mthol lo bshags/ /'gro kun thog med dus kyi drin can ma/ /byang chub sgrub pa'i rgyu ru ma shes par/ /la la dgra dang la la gnyen du bzung*/ /chags sdang 'thab rtsod bgyis pa mthol lo bshags/ khyad par byang chub sgrub pa'i grogs kyi mchog

/tshangs pa mtshungs par spyod dang rdo rje'i spun/ /dag snang gus par ma byas phrag dog dang*/ /brnyas chos khro 'khrug bgyis pa mthol lo bshags/ /tshe 'di'i che thabs 'ba' zhig lhur blangs nas/ /nges 'byung thar pa'i bsam pa ma bskyed cing*// snying rje byang chub sems la ma sbyangs pas/ /lam gyi rtsa ba 'dor ba mthol lo bshags/ /bshes gnyen ma bsten sdom gsum ma blangs shing*// rlabs chen phyin drug spyod pa yal bar dor/ /zhi lhag bskyed rdzogs ting 'dzin ma bsgoms pas/ /lam gyi ngo bor dor bar mthol lo bshags/ /thog med dus nas chos dang gang zag gi /bdag tu 'dzin pas blo mig bsgribs pa 'di// sbyong byed yang dag lta ba ma btsal bas/ /lam gyi bdag rkyen dor ba mthol lo bshags| |'gro la blang dor gnas rnams ma bstan zhing*/ /skal bzang theg chen lam du ma bcug dang*/ /bsdu dngos bzhi yis gzhan don ma byas pas// lam gyi byed las dor ba mthol lo bshags/ /bsam gtan gzugs med zad par zil gnon dang*/ /spyan dang mngon shes la sogs grub pa dang*/ /las bzhi grub chen brgyad sogs ma sbyangs pas/ /lam gyi yon tan dor ba mthol lo bshags| khyad par mthon po'i lam la yid smon nas/ /thog mar bsgrub rgyu'i lam rnams khyad du bsad/ /lta ba mthon po'i stong skad kha bad kyis/ /spyod pa yal bar dor ba mthol lo bshags/ /rang gzhan grub mtha' rgya mtsho'i rnam dbye dang*/ /zab yangs lung gi dgongs pa ma shes pas/ /rang nyid gang la zhen pa'i phyogs bzung nas/ /gsung rab rang bzor bkral ba mthol lo bshags// phyi rgyud nyan thos spyod pa ma sbyangs shing*/ /nang du rdo rje theg la ma dad dang*// 'gro la phan pa'i bsam sbyor zhen pa yis/ /gsang sngags log par spyad pa mthol lo bshags/ /sbyang rtog sbar gsum ma nus dam rdzas bsten/ /bsnyen sgrub tshad du ma 'khyol las la sbyar/ /rtsa rlung nus pa ma thon 'dod pa spyad/ /rgyu med 'bras bu btsal ba mthol lo bshags/

/bde 'dod nyon mongs dbang gis sdug bsngal bsgrubs/ /mkhas 'dod le lo'i dbang gis chos ma bslabs// grol 'dod snang shes dbang gis 'khor bar bcings/ /'bras 'dod rgyu dang bral ba mthol lo bshags/ /bslu med dkon mchog skyabs su bstan bzhin du| |nyams thag tshe na mgon skyabs 'dre la 'chol/ /mi tshe chos la bskyal nas rkyen byung tshe/ /sems rgyud chos dang bral ba mthol lo bshags/ khyad par bstan srung dam pa mchog gi mchog /'khor dang bcas pa'i spyi dang khyad par gyi| |dam tshig rnams dang 'gal bar gyur ba yi/ /mi dges thugs kyis khrel ba mthol lo bshags/ /bsnyen sgrub g.yel bas thugs dam ma 'khul zhing*// mchod gtor zhan pas thugs dam ma bskangs dang*/ /gtsang sbra chung bas 'bags dang bshams nyes sogs/ /thugs dang 'gal ba bgyis pa mthol lo bshags| |mdor na sgo gsum nyon mongs dbang gyur pas/ /bcas dang rang bzhin kha na ma tho ba/ /ci mchis 'gyod pa'i sems kyis bshags par bgyi// dmigs med thugs rje'i ngang gis bzod par bzhes/ /phyin chad mkhyen ldan rnams kyi thugs rje yis/ /sngar byas lam gyi mi mthun phyogs 'di dag/ring du spangs nas zab mo'i lam mchog kun/ /myur du rgyud la rdzogs par mdzad du gsol/ /de ltar sdig pa'i tshogs kun bshags pa dang*/ /byis pa chung ngu phama'i rjes slob ltar/ /bdag gzhan dge ba'i rtsa ba ci mchis pa/ /gcig tu bsdus nas bstan srung thugs dam bskang*/ /bdag gzhan bdag med rtogs pa'i ral gri yis/ /bdag 'dzin dgra bgegs bsgral ba las byung ba'i// gzhan don chags pa'i sman raka mchod yon 'dis/ /bstan srung 'khor dang bcas pa'i thugs dam bskang*/ /dad mos mdangs gsal dbang po'i me tog dang*| |rnam dag tshul khrims gsur chen bdug spos dang*/ /rnam dpyod gsal ba'i zhun chen sgron me yis/ /bstan srung 'khor dang bcas pa'i thugs dam bskang*| |bde stong sim byed byang sems dṛ mchog dang*/

/ting 'dzin bdud rtsi'i sha khrag zhal zas dang*/ /bstod dbyangs snyan pa'i rkang gling thod rnga yis// bstan srung 'khor dang bcas pa'i thugs dam bskang*/ /byang chub sems kyi gtor chen ri rab tsam/ /yon tan bye ba'i sha khrag dmar gyis brgyan/ /mang thos ro ldan dza gad chang phud kyis/ /bstan srung 'khor dang bcas pa'i thugs dam bskang*/ /'dod chags chos nyid g.yag rog sprin ltar gtibs/ /zhe sdang gnas lugs khyi nag dom ltar 'phyo/ /gti mug rang bzhin lug nag 'tsher ba 'dis| |bstan srung 'khor dang bcas pa'i thugs dam bskang*/ /gzhan yang dam nyams phyi nang bsgral ba yi/ /g.yang gzhi'i bla re rgyu ma'i lda ldi dang*// shugs chen rta nag rgyan gyis brgyan pa dang*/ /bya nag sogs kyis khyod kyi thugs dam bskang*/ /de ltar rmad du byung ba'i dam rdzas 'dis/ /bstan srung dam pa 'khor dang bcas rnams kyi/ /thugs dam gnyen po myur du bskangs gyur nas// bstan 'dzin bdag gi mgon dang stong grogs mdzod/ khyad par sngags 'chang bdag gi dge ba'i las/ /'jig rten khams su phan bde 'byung ba'i gzhi/ /ma lus 'gro ba'i ded dpon phyogs 'di ru/ /'byung ba'i mthun rkyen rnam dag myur sgrubs shig /'dir 'bad dge ba nyin mor byed pa 'dis/ /thub bstan shar ri'i rtse mor shar ba yis/ /legs bshad pad tshogs phyogs mthar rab rgyas nas| |phan bde sbrang rtsi'i dpal la rol gyur cig/ces bstan srung dam pa rnams la bstod cing bskang bshags su gsol ba 'di dag gtsang stag tshang gi lo tsā ba shes rab rin chen rgyal mtshan dpal bzang pos sbyar ba'i dge bas bstan pa rin po che dar rgyas yun ring du gnas par bya ba'i phyir bsngo'o// maṅgalaṃ// // mes po'i shul bzhag las/ stag tshang lo tsā ba shes rab rin chen gyi bka' 'bum/chos skyong spyi yi bskang bshags gur mgon zhal dang bcas pa'i bstod pa/ -PAGE 172--PAGE 171-- PAGE 168-
